name: Quick Security Check
description: Fast scan focusing on critical misconfigurations and high-severity issues. Ideal for rapid triage or initial assessment of a new domain.

name: OWASP Top 10
description: Comprehensive testing against all OWASP Top 10 2021 vulnerabilities including injection attacks, broken authentication, security misconfigurations, vulnerable components, and more.

name: API Security Scan
description: Focused testing for REST APIs, GraphQL, and other API endpoints. Covers JWT vulnerabilities, CORS misconfiguration, authentication bypass, mass assignment, and API-specific OWASP Top 10.

name: Full Security Assessment
description: Complete scan including CVEs, misconfigurations, exposed admin panels, all vulnerability categories, technology fingerprinting, and subdomain takeover checks. Most thorough assessment available.

name: PCI-DSS Compliance Scan
description: Security scans mapped to PCI-DSS 4.0 requirements. Tests for injection vulnerabilities, authentication weaknesses, cryptographic failures, and misconfigurations relevant to cardholder data environments.

name: HIPAA Security Scan
description: Scans aligned to HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards. Covers authentication controls, encryption in transit, access controls, and audit trail requirements for ePHI systems.

name: AI & Modern API Security
description: Tests AI/ML endpoints, LLM APIs, chatbot interfaces, and modern API patterns including WebSockets, gRPC, and GraphQL subscriptions. Covers prompt injection, model data extraction, and API-specific vulnerabilities.

name: CVE & Known Vulnerability Scan
description: Scans for known CVEs in web technologies, frameworks, CMS platforms, and server software. Identifies unpatched vulnerabilities with public exploits.
